steps.title: Pour a potion
steps.body: Tap one flask, then tap another with the same color on top. Four matching layers brew a potion.

steps.title: Tap this flask
steps.body: Pick up the highlighted flask. You always pour the color sitting on top.

steps.title: Pour it here
steps.body: This flask matches, so the pour is legal. One tap completes your first potion.

steps.title: Keep brewing
steps.body: Red damages the guardian. Green restores HP. Blue grants Shield. Purple poisons through Armor. Fill flasks until the guardian falls.
